seo.title: Why Guided Travel?
seo.description: Why travelling with a local expert guide gives you a safer, richer and worry-free holiday in Nepal, and supports the local economy.

content.title: Why Guided Travel?
content.body:
Travelling involves visiting new places and learning about the destinations you visit. The neighbouring countries Tibet and Bhutan have applied a controlled and guided tourism policy. All travellers must take guided tours, and no tourists are allowed to travel solo or individually without an organized tour and guide in Tibet and Bhutan.

However, you are allowed to visit the most tourist places in Nepal (except some of the controlled areas) without a guide. We at Joyful Trekking focus on Guided Travel and here are some reasons why you should take Guided Holidays in Nepal:

  • To know the destination well: You can visit most places in Nepal without a guide. However, you will only look at them and take some photographs, and you will never know the stories behind those historical sites. The historical places in Kathmandu and other parts of Nepal have a long history, many stories, legends, arts and architecture, and you know them well when you take a guided tour in Nepal. We offer a local expert guide who interprets the destination, people, culture, lifestyle, history, geography, political systems, and much more. No one can interpret a destination better than the locals, so you will have authentic information about it.
  • To travel safely: Trekking, hiking, climbing and expeditions in Nepal go into the high Himalayas, and it is risky to travel alone without a guide in those remote areas. Many individual trekkers have been lost because some trekking trails go into high ridges, thick forest and across streams. You may lose your way in small mistakes, so we recommend you travel with a local guide.
  • To travel without worry: When you travel guided with us, we arrange all the related travel services from your arrival at the airport to your departure from Nepal. The arrangement includes airport transfers, accommodation, transport, flights, tours, guides, porters, permits, entrance fees, and whatever else is needed. You do not need to worry about anything and can enjoy your holiday to the fullest.
  • To support the local economy: When you book guided travel, it supports the local rural economy of Nepal. Nepal is facing an unemployment problem, and tourism is a fast-growing industry that can offer job opportunities to thousands of people. Your travel to Nepal can provide jobs to many people, including organizers, guides, drivers and porters. Your travel with us will help Nepal's local economy.

Namaste, and see you soon.
